title: common
description: Shared definitions of the dest-cli contract v1: the JSON of `cpa dest pending|send|drop|usual|test --send` and `cpa filing send` with --json (docs/25 §5.4, §5.5). Unknown fields are always allowed; pattern follows ECMA-262. Only keywords the WhisperWoof validator knows are used (protocol/filing/tools/check_filing.KEYWORDS), so one validator reads both contracts.

ref.description: What waits or was sent: a recording id (MonoId, upper case) or another capture's id (a typed note's outbox id).

destId.description: A destination id: the kind, or <kind>.<name> with a name of at most 12 characters (docs/25 §2.2).

fl.description: The destination's flags (docs/25 §2.2), letters in this order: l live (only while you are there, never replayed), c leaves the Mac, p needs a project, k each capture is confirmed on the device. A reader that cannot read it treats it as lck.

label.description: A destination's label, display_safe: 1-24 UTF-8 bytes where it is stored, so at most 24 characters here.

code.description: A fixed error or failure code; an extensible enum: show an unknown one as it is.

time.description: An ISO 8601 time with its zone, as events.jsonl has it.

via.description: How another app was handed the text: url (a pre-fill link) or clip (the clipboard, the app brought forward).
